props.text: Canvas-adapted SPoG · live pens + Utility Tracker baselines · metering roadmap
Groveport site dashboard with enterprise matrix placeholders (Cascade / Eneroi / Innovative). Line-break restart baselines from Utility Tracker. Area metering coverage on classic EPMS tab.
Primary power — monthly electricity (k-kWh) vs baselines
Actual demand vs 3-yr average and 7-yr high/low envelope (last 12 months from Utility Tracker).
Monthly k-lb series is stubbed until production historian rolls up. Live MTD volume is on the KPI strip.
Temp from Utility Tracker. Therm series is a weather-shaped stub until gas meters feed.
Cascade / Eneroi / Innovative matrix from the executive canvas. Groveport row highlighted — bind to live site tags as metering rolls out.
From the executive canvas — Ignition Perspective capabilities to close utility gaps.
Subtract HDD/CDD effects so summer/winter spikes don't look like inefficiency.
Alert before a new monthly kW peak sets a 12-month ratchet charge.
Tie utility cost to MES batches / SKUs instead of P&L overhead.
Groveport PF alert path — kVAR monitoring + capacitor bank triggers.
eGRID factors → one-click carbon reports from metered kWh / therms.
Historian clustering for weekend baseload and non-op waste.
